## Tango, gauchos, Argentine steaks and Mendoza wines

This seven-day itinerary brings together two of Argentina's most distinctive flavours. In Buenos Aires, you will discover historic neighbourhoods, architecture, tango and gaucho traditions. You then travel to Mendoza, where the programme continues among vineyards and wineries at the foot of the Andes.

The trip suits travellers interested in the country's food and wine: Argentine beef, wine, a traditional estancia lunch and tastings. It is also a full travel itinerary, with a city tour of the capital, free days and a choice of activities in Mendoza.

Buenos Aires provides the cultural opening: architecture, old neighbourhoods, urban history and tango. Mendoza changes the pace, with fewer dense city streets and more open spaces, vineyards and proximity to the Andes. On your free day, you can continue exploring the wines or choose an active outing, adding rafting, horseback riding or a mountain trip.
